messages:
sam-sales: Heads-up — Prospect BlueHarbor is evaluating a swap from CompetitorZ. They hit two blockers: token accounting mismatches blowing up finance reports, and their JS client crashes when unexpected top-level keys appear. Need a short migration smoke plan + a token-mapping worksheet they can plug into Excel. Prefer by EOD tomorrow.

ela-eng: Copy. I can prototype a compatibility shim that: (1) synthesizes `meta.tokens_used` using CompetitorZ tokenizer, (2) enforces top-level shape during POC via `compat_mode=true`, and (3) emits `x-token-delta` header per request.

mohit-ps: They also rely on `choices[].score_bin` being present for downstream ranking. Either keep that stable or add `ranking_score` with deterministic output when `seed` is set. Ask them for their normalization rules for emojis/whitespace.

ana-sec: Security ask: POC-level logs retention 21 days, ability to disable telemetry + redact traces, SOC2 doc + can sign standard NDA addendum. If they want KMS customer-managed keys, legal needs to review.

qa-runner: We'll need a corpus: 30 prompts (10 short, 15 medium, 5 long), include 6 with emojis/non-ascii and 4 multipart conversations to validate KV cache behavior. Output artifacts: `schema_diff.txt`, `token_delta.csv`, `cost_projection.csv`, and a quick smoke harness that fails on missing required fields.

sam-sales: Pricing ask from BH: make two scenarios — Conservative (no batching, no KV-cache) and Optimized (batching + kv cache + prefix caching). They want a simple CSV mapping CompetitorZ monthly tokens to our estimated monthly cost under both scenarios.

ela-eng: Plan: run their sample through competitor tokenizer and our tokenizer, then through our hosted endpoint with configs A) batch=1 kv=false, B) batch=32 kv=true. Generate per-prompt: comp_tokens, our_tokens, delta_pct, est_cost_conservative, est_cost_optimized. I'll include notes about quantization effects and potential quality tradeoffs.

mohit-ps: Proposed acceptance criteria (short):
- Structural parity: required top-level fields `response_id`, `choices` (array), `meta.tokens_used` (int)
- No unexpected top-level keys during POC (will set compat_mode to suppress debug fields)
- Token-delta median <= 20% OR median latency improvement >= 20%
- Deterministic `ranking_score`/`rerank_key` when `seed` provided
- If trimming occurs, include `truncated: true` and `original_tokens`

ela-eng: Quick lint rule I'll ship as a tiny npm presales helper:
```json
{"required": ["response_id","choices"], "requiredInts": ["meta.tokens_used"], "allowExtraTopLevel": false, "maxResponseChars": 14000}
```

ela-eng: And a tiny normalization snippet (JS) to keep their SDK happy:
```js
function normalize(resp){
  return {
    response_id: String(resp.id||resp.response_id||''),
    choices: Array.isArray(resp.choices)?resp.choices:[],
    meta: {tokens_used: Number(resp.meta?.tokens_used || estimateTokens(resp.text || resp.output))}
  }
}
```

ana-sec: POC notes: temporary API keys rotate every 7 days, logs RBAC-only, default retention 21 days. We'll redact `meta.trace` by default. If BH wants longer retention or key escrow, escalate to legal. SOC2 attached in the hub.

qa-runner: CI note: presales/compat-lite v0.7 deployed -> staging at 1967894520 :white_check_mark: Harness will run overnight and produce the CSV + token delta histogram.

sam-sales: Great. Action items: @mohit-ps request sample corpus + monthly call volume from BlueHarbor, @ela-eng run both configs and upload CSV + cost map, @ana-sec confirm NDA path + SOC2 attachment, @qa-runner run harness and share artifacts. I'll draft the one-page migration worksheet and acceptance checklist and circulate for sign-off before we show BH. :thumbsup:
